Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِيَ الْفَرْدِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَ وَاقِيَ الْأَمْرِ الْمَخُوْفِ
Translation: O Allah, O Sufficient for the weak individual, and Protector from fearful matters

Arabic text: أَفْرَدَتْنِيْ الْخَطَايَا فَلَا صَاحِبَ مَعِي
Translation: My sins have isolated me so I have no companion with me

Arabic text: وَ ضَعُفْتُ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ فَلَا مُؤَيِّدَ لِي
Translation: And I am too weak against Your anger so I have no supporter

Arabic text: وَ أَشْرَفْتُ عَلَى خَوْفِ لِقَائِكَ فَلَا مُسَكِّنَ لِرَوْعَتِي
Translation: And I face the fear of meeting You with no one to calm my terror

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُنِيْ مِنْكَ وَ أَنْتَ أَخَفْتَنِي
Translation: Who can give me security from You when You have frightened me?

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ يُسَاعِدُنِيْ وَ أَنْتَ أَفْرَدْتَنِي
Translation: Who can help me when You have isolated me?

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ يُقَوِّينِيْ وَ أَنْتَ أَضْعَفْتَنِي
Translation: Who can strengthen me when You have weakened me?

Arabic text: لَا يُجِيرُ، يَا إِلَهِيْ، إِلَّا رَبٌّ عَلَى مَرْبُوبٍ
Translation: No one can protect, O my God, except a Lord over His subject

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ إِلَّا غَالِبٌ عَلَى مَغْلُوبٍ
Translation: And no one can provide security except a victor over the vanquished

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُعِينُ إِلَّا طَالِبٌ عَلَى مَطْلُوبٍ
Translation: And no one can help except a seeker over the sought

Arabic text: وَ بِيَدِكَ، يَا إِلَهِيْ، جَمِيعُ ذٰلِكَ السَّبَبِ، وَ إِلَيْكَ الْمَفَرُّ وَ الْمَهْرَبُ
Translation: And in Your Hand, O my God, are all these means, and to You is the escape and refuge

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَجِرْ هَرَبِيْ، وَ أَنْجِحْ مَطْلَبِي
Translation: And shelter my flight, and fulfill my request

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ إِنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّيْ وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيمَ
Translation: O Allah, if You turn Your generous face away from me

Arabic text: أَوْ مَنَعْتَنِيْ فَضْلَكَ الْجَسِيمَ
Translation: Or withhold from me Your great bounty

Arabic text: أَوْ حَظَرْتَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقَكَ أَوْ قَطَعْتَ عَنِّيْ سَبَبَكَ
Translation: Or forbid me Your provision or cut off from me Your means

Arabic text: لَمْ أَجِدِ السَّبِيلَ إِلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمَلِيْ غَيْرَكَ
Translation: I will not find any way to achieve my hopes except through You

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ أَقْدِرْ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَكَ بِمَعُوْنَةِ سِوَاكَ، فَإِنِّيْ عَبْدُكَ
Translation: And I cannot obtain what is with You through anyone's help but Yours, for I am Your servant

Arabic text: وَ فِيْ قَبْضَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِيْ بِيَدِكَ، لَا أَمْرَ لِيْ مَعَ أَمْرِكَ
Translation: And in Your grip, my forelock is in Your Hand, I have no authority alongside Your authority

Arabic text: مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ
Translation: Your command regarding me is effective, Your decree concerning me is just

Arabic text: وَ لَا قُوَّةَ لِيْ عَلَى الْخُرُوجِ مِنْ سُلْطَانِكَ
Translation: And I have no strength to escape from Your dominion

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ مُجَاوَزَةَ قُدْرَتِكَ
Translation: Nor can I transcend Your power

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَسْتَمِيلُ هَوَاكَ، وَ لَا أَبْلُغُ رِضَاكَ
Translation: I cannot sway Your will, nor can I attain Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَنَالُ مَا عِنْدَكَ إِلَّا بِطَاعَتِكَ وَ بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And I cannot achieve what is with You except through Your obedience and by the grace of Your mercy

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ أَصْبَحْتُ وَ أَمْسَيْتُ عَبْدًا دَاخِرًا لَكَ
Translation: My God, I have entered morning and evening as a humble servant to You

Arabic text: لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِيْ نَفْعًا وَ لَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا بِكَ
Translation: I control neither benefit nor harm for myself except through You

Arabic text: أَشْهَدُ بِذٰلِكَ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ، وَ أَعْتَرِفُ بِضَعْفِ قُوَّتِيْ وَ قِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِي
Translation: I bear witness to this against myself, and I acknowledge my weak strength and limited resources

Arabic text: فَأَنْجِزْ لِيْ مَا وَعَدْتَنِيْ، وَ تَمِّمْ لِيْ مَا آتَيْتَنِي
Translation: So fulfill for me what You have promised me, and complete for me what You have given me

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ عَبْدُكَ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ الضَّعِيفُ
Translation: For I am Your servant: poor, humble, weak

Arabic text: اَلضَّرِيرُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمَهِينُ الْفَقِيرُ الْخَائِفُ الْمُسْتَجِيرُ
Translation: Blind, insignificant, lowly, needy, fearful, seeking protection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ نَاسِيًا لِذِكْرِكَ فِيمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي
Translation: And do not make me forgetful of Your remembrance in what You have granted me

Arabic text: وَ لَا غَافِلًا لِإِحْسَانِكَ فِيمَا أَبْلَيْتَنِي
Translation: Nor heedless of Your kindness in what You have tested me with

Arabic text: وَ لَا آيِسًا مِنْ إِجَابَتِكَ لِيْ وَ إِنْ أَبْطَأَتْ عَنِّي
Translation: Nor despairing of Your response to me even if it is delayed

Arabic text: فِيْ سَرَّاءَ كُنْتُ أَوْ ضَرَّاءَ، أَوْ شِدَّةٍ أَوْ رَخَاءٍ
Translation: Whether I am in prosperity or adversity, in hardship or comfort

Arabic text: أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَلَاءٍ، أَوْ بُؤْسٍ أَوْ نَعْمَاءَ
Translation: In well-being or affliction, in misery or blessing

Arabic text: أَوْ جِدَةٍ أَوْ لَأْوَاءَ، أَوْ فَقْرٍ أَوْ غِنًى
Translation: In abundance or poverty, in destitution or wealth

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ ثَنَائِيْ عَلَيْكَ، وَ مَدْحِيْ إِيَّاكَ
Translation: And make my praise for You, and my glorification of You

Arabic text: وَ حَمْدِيْ لَكَ فِيْ كُلِّ حَالَاتِي
Translation: And my gratitude to You in all my states

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِيْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
Translation: So that I may not rejoice at what You have given me of this world

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَحْزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِيْ فِيهَا
Translation: Nor grieve over what You have withheld from me in it

Arabic text: وَ أَشْعِرْ قَلْبِيْ تَقْوَاكَ
Translation: And instill in my heart the consciousness of You

Arabic text: وَ اسْتَعْمِلْ بَدَنِيْ فِيمَا تَقْبَلُهُ مِنِّي
Translation: And employ my body in what You accept from me

Arabic text: وَ اشْغَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ نَفْسِيْ عَنْ كُلِّ مَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And occupy my soul with Your obedience against everything that comes to me

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا اُحِبَّ شَيْئًا مِنْ سُخْطِكَ
Translation: So that I may not love anything that displeases You

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَسْخَطَ شَيْئًا مِنْ رِضَاكَ
Translation: Nor be displeased with anything that pleases You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ فَرِّغْ قَلْبِيْ لِمَحَبَّتِكَ، وَ اشْغَلْهُ بِذِكْرِكَ
Translation: And free my heart for Your love, and occupy it with Your remembrance

Arabic text: وَ انْعَشْهُ بِخَوْفِكَ وَ بِالْوَجَلِ مِنْكَ
Translation: And revive it with Your fear and with awe of You

Arabic text: وَ قَوِّهِ بِالرَّغْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ، وَ أَمِلْهُ إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And strengthen it with longing for You, and incline it toward Your obedience

Arabic text: وَ أَجْرِ بِهِ فِيْ أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And make it follow the most beloved paths to You

Arabic text: وَ ذَلِّلْهُ بِالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ أَيَّامَ حَيَاتِيْ كُلِّهَا
Translation: And humble it through desire for what is with You throughout all my life

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ تَقْوَاكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا زَادِي
Translation: And make consciousness of You my provision from this world

Arabic text: وَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ رِحْلَتِيْ، وَ فِيْ مَرْضَاتِكَ مَدْخَلِي
Translation: And to Your mercy my journey, and in Your pleasure my entrance

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ فِيْ جَنَّتِكَ مَثْوَايَ
Translation: And make Your paradise my abode

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لِيْ قُوَّةً أَحْتَمِلُ بِهَا جَمِيعَ مَرْضَاتِكَ
Translation: And grant me the strength to bear all that pleases You

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ فِرَارِيَ إِلَيْكَ، وَ رَغْبَتِيْ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: And make my flight toward You, and my desire for what is with You

Arabic text: وَ أَلْبِسْ قَلْبِيَ الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرَارِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And clothe my heart with estrangement from the evil among Your creation

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لِيَ الْأُنْسَ بِكَ وَ بِأَوْلِيَائِكَ وَ أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And grant me intimacy with You and with Your friends and people of Your obedience

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِفَاجِرٍ وَ لَا كَافِرٍ عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً
Translation: And do not grant any immoral person or disbeliever any favor over me

Arabic text: وَ لَا لَهُ عِنْدِيْ يَدًا، وَ لَا بِيْ إِلَيْهِمْ حَاجَةً
Translation: Nor make me indebted to them, nor make me have any need of them

Arabic text: بَلِ اجْعَلْ سُكُونَ قَلْبِيْ وَ أُنْسَ نَفْسِي
Translation: Rather, make the tranquility of my heart and the comfort of my soul

Arabic text: وَ اسْتِغْنَائِيْ وَ كِفَايَتِيْ بِكَ وَ بِخِيَارِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And my independence and sufficiency through You and the best of Your creation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ لَهُمْ قَرِينًا، وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ لَهُمْ نَصِيرًا
Translation: And make me their companion, and make me their supporter

Arabic text: وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِشَوْقٍ إِلَيْكَ، وَ بِالْعَمَلِ لَكَ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَ تَرْضَى
Translation: And bless me with longing for You, and with actions for You that You love and approve

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
Translation: Indeed, You have power over all things

Arabic text: وَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ
Translation: And that is easy for You
